expectations.note: A value refinement cannot carry a unit or a scale; the current type form has no place for either. The destination stays a basic type because the gap is recorded, not because a Core type was added.
A record is a named product and a tuple is a positional one; the current type form carries names only, so the positional composition is a gap.
Order, multiplicity and completeness are declared separately, so the ordered collection is carried by the facets without a Core enumeration.
Key equality is a declared facet, and the descriptor cannot state it; 1 and "1" are not the same key by accident.
A tree is direction, cycle and parent arity added to a relation. The multigraph stays a relation and the tree stays its projection, so no sibling Core type is needed.
Domain and observation axes are declared separately and no other axis is invented; the time family is carried by facets plus a plugin candidate.
type Length from std.decimal unit "mm" is a parse error today, so the unit and the point/delta scale have no place in the Source form.
A CRS and the named dimensions are separate from the index layout; a coordinate pair is not a safe distance computation.
Purity and effect belong to a call, not to its rendering; the current Source form has no place for them.
A state set and its transitions are declared separately; an enumeration is not a state set.
core-type is not an available destination. The request goes back to the Owner rather than being granted.
A sequence is read as ordered, unique and complete. Multiplicity, order and completeness are declared facets and cannot be inferred.
Two types sharing std.decimal are not the same unit. The base type never establishes a unit, so the missing declaration is a gap.
A recorded counterexample does not grant the Core type. The request is returned to the Owner; the reference only records that the facets did not carry the case.
